title: Plan Feedback Write V1 (the answer to recording one report)
$comment: DL-KB-16. `stored: true` says the bytes are in the state database. `plan_states_unchanged` is a constant true, not a measurement the writer decided: recording feedback must not move 已保存/已提供/已选用 and must not turn 外部未验证 into verified -- test_plan_feedback pins that a readback taken before and after a report is byte-identical. `claims_not_made` keeps the denials on the answer itself.
